# Get-ZbxGraphItem

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the items a graph plots, with how it draws each.

## SYNTAX

### ById (Default)

```
Get-ZbxGraphItem [-Id] <ulong[]> [-Limit <int>] [-SelectGraphs] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByItem

```
Get-ZbxGraphItem -ItemId <ulong[]> [-Limit <int>] [-SelectGraphs] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxGraphItem cmdlet reads graph items with graphitem.get: for each item a graph plots, its color, draw style, function and Y axis side. It selects by graph (-Id, or a graph piped from Get-ZbxGraph) or by item (-ItemId); graph items have no name, so there is no -Name or -Filter. -SelectGraphs adds each graph item's graphs. It writes ZabbixGraphItem objects and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get the items of a graph

```powershell
Get-ZbxGraph -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Request rate' | Get-ZbxGraphItem | Select-Object ItemId, Color, DrawType
```

A graph piped from Get-ZbxGraph binds -Id by its GraphId.

### Example 2: Find the graphs that plot an item

```powershell
Get-ZbxGraphItem -ItemId $item.ItemId -SelectGraphs | ForEach-Object { $_.Graphs.Name }
```

-ItemId selects by item instead; -SelectGraphs adds each graph item's graphs.
